name: Norawit Titicharoenrak
description: '''Norawit Titicharoenrak''' ({{langx|th| นรวิชญ์ ฐิติเจริญรักษ์}}; born 13 June 2004), nicknamed '''Gemini''' ({{langx|th|เจมีไนน์}}), is a Thai actor under [[GMMTV]] and a singer under [[Riser Music]]. He first gained attention through the reality television program ''Thailand School Star 2019'' and rose to prominence for his role as Tinn in the series ''[[My School President]]'' (2022) and as Heart in ''[[Moonlight Chicken]]'' (2023). He is also known for his role as Barth in ''[[Ticket to Heaven (TV series)|Ticket to Heaven]]'' (2026).
